svg.title: A static copy shows a recorded call and checks it again
svg.text: Record the model once. Run the rule every time.
no model; the box is disabled
the rule runs again at build,
a stored verdict is never shown
so: a copy without the model is still honest. It says the answer is a recording and when it was made,
it offers only the questions that were recorded, and the verdict a reader sees is computed where they read it
